title: Vegan Gooey Garlic Stir Fry
description: A flavorful stir fry made with garlic, gooey sauce, and a blend of spices, perfect for a quick and easy vegan meal.

ingredients.name: Gooey sauce
ingredients.notes: Make sure to choose a vegan-friendly gooey sauce

ingredients.name: Stir-fry mix
ingredients.notes: You can use a pre-mixed stir-fry mix or create your own blend with your favorite vegetables

ingredients.name: Sumac
ingredients.notes: Add a Middle Eastern twist to your stir fry with sumac

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the stir-fry mix and cook for 3-4 minutes until it starts to soften.
Pour in the gooey sauce and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes until the sauce is bubbly and the vegetables are tender.
Sprinkle sumac over the top and serve hot.
